freeCareMaxFpl.quote: Households with income at or below 200% of the federal poverty guideline receive a 100% discount on hospital charges.

tiers.quote: Households with income between 201% and 300% of the federal poverty guideline receive a 75% discount; households between 301% and 400% receive a 50% discount.

windowDays.quote: Applications are accepted up to 240 days after the date of the first billing statement following discharge.
